conventions.form: EndpointOK (formal/lean/Formal/Core/Substrate/CornerNat.lean): for every data path P and every request path Q of a form, sum over P of each arc's upper delay + margin_ps <= sum over Q of each arc's lower delay, both measured from the form's common `launch` event. With a corner model this is EndpointOK kappa (path P) (path Q) (margin + |P| + |Q|) (bundle_band, one ps of rounding per arc); with fixed intervals it is shard C's 10a race check.
conventions.combine: 'all': every form must hold (default). 'any': the obligation holds if one form holds (RT1, RT1b: race OR structural).
conventions.names: cell-relative: `<lut instance>.<logical pin>` (I0..I5, O5, O6); `<u>.<pin>@pip` is the site-pin input of that LUT pin. The checker maps logical pins to the physical A1..A6 the router chose (routed JSON X_ORIG_PORT_A<k> / ROUTING sitewire, or FASM). `{I0|I1}` = max (data side) or min (request side) over those pins. Bracketed indices (ctl[i], lat[b]) are pipe stages.

arc_kinds.lut_arc: cell IOPATH from a logical input pin to an output (prjxray per pin/output: O6 45/124 flat over pins; O5 from I0/I1 44/152, from I2 42/150; FAST_MIN/SLOW_MAX ps). nextpnr SDF: flat 124.
arc_kinds.site_pin: input site-pin buffer of the physical LUT pin, SP[pin]; prjxray tile_type_CLBL{L,M}_{L,R}.json (fast_min, fast_max, slow_min, slow_max) ps: A1 (172,214,416,516), A2 (170,212,409,507), A3 (107,133,278,344), A4 (86,107,229,284), A5 (33,42,91,112), A6 (2,2,4,5); SLICEM A1 up to 531, D1 540. nextpnr SDF: flat 25 ps (then subtract 25 from INTERCONNECT if it includes the site pip; check on one SDF).
arc_kinds.wire: routed INTERCONNECT from a driver output to a sink pin, excluding the site pin (prjxray pips + Elmore RC, or SDF band).
arc_kinds.feedback_wire: routed wire from a LUT's output back to its own input pin (the loop wire; tighten.loop_wire).
arc_kinds.line: traversal of a bd_delay line (or request/DACK line) for one edge along a named path (chain/ripple/tap/fastest); expands to wire + LUT arcs per hop.
arc_kinds.env: a segment outside the cell (neighbour response, server, sender, protocol latency); resolved by the checker by walking the routed netlist when it is inside the design, else an environment hypothesis.
arc_kinds.cell_param: datasheet / chipdb constant (BRAM tSU, tHD, tCO, tPWH).

conventions.lean_sym: the symbol the arc instantiates in the cited Lean statement (dlmax, dwmax, wfa1, ...).
conventions.site_pins: `needed` = the obligation's exact form contains per-pin site delays; `roles` = which logical pin roles and on which side. The SDF cannot see them (flat 25 ps).
conventions.corner_rule: prjxray's two IOPATH triples are FAST and SLOW corners, NOT rise and fall (ArbCorners.prj_is_mix; prjxray makesdf.py:63). NEVER take a rise arc from FAST and a fall arc from SLOW. Modes: '1C' = both sides from one column, checked at FAST_MIN and at SLOW_MAX (or EndpointOK with kappa over a shared corner); 'box' = every hi at SLOW_MAX and every lo at FAST_MIN independently (always sound, pessimistic); '1C_both_corners_required' = a SLOW_MAX-only check is NOT enough (RT1b). A SLOW_MAX-only margin needs the guard As - Af/k (fast_neg_iff; As - Af if k <= 1, guard_universal). Rise = fall within a column (H_RF_ASYM unmeasured).
conventions.status: 'proved' = every cited sufficient theorem exists in a tracked file; 'unproved' = the inequality is not a Lean statement (extrapolated, physical reading of an untimed result, or no theorem).
conventions.exactness: sufficient | sufficient+necessary (a counter-trace shows the condition cannot be dropped) | sufficient+necessary_at_boundary/instance (tight on a concrete trace, not a general iff) | exact (iff) | sufficient+necessary_untimed (S/N in an untimed model; the delay inequality is its physical reading) | untimed_schedule | hypothesis (a named assumption the cell theorems use, not derived) | sufficient_by_arithmetic | see_refers_to | partial (status stays 'unproved': a weaker statement than the entry is proved; exactness_note says what is missing) | unproved.
conventions.rule_verdicts: exact | conservative | missing_term (rule weaker; `missing` names the term) | exact_arcs_missing_site_pins | conservative_arcs_missing_site_pins | rule_is_the_check | different_condition | none (no rule checks it) | uncheckable_statically.
conventions.check_scope: static_route (route + prjxray only) | route_plus_env (needs a neighbour or environment latency; static when the neighbour is in the design) | environment | protocol | structural | not_static.
conventions.exact_under: optional list of named side conditions: the entry's 'exact' holds only under them; outside them it is sufficient only.
conventions.strictness: Bs (formal/notes/B-celem-strict.md, Formal/Cells/CElemStrict.lean): in the per-pin Kleene mux-tree model (H_TREE, H_MUX_KLEENE: a moving select reads X on [s, s + wa), wa >= 1 tick; H_FB_PURE) the own-feedback race is clean iff dlmax + dwmax + wa <= dlmin + E (env_latency_iff), so with the grid minimum wa = 1 ps every own-feedback race entry reads L + 1 <= R (env_latency_strict; at equality bd_c2 reads X, boundary_x) and every held width >= Dmax + 1. Entries carrying `strict` have margin_ps raised by 1 on the forms it lists; their earlier '<=' theorems are proved with instantaneous selects (wa = 0, env_latency_atomic) and remain sufficient. The 1 ps is the model's minimum, NOT a measured slew: the physical margin is the departing select's X width (with SDF 50% arrival times about half the sum of the two select slews), which nothing here measures. `strict_pending` marks input-against-input orders where the same mechanism may apply but has not been checked; they stay '<='.
conventions.guards_in_rules: tighten.py A, D, F, H, I, K, L add req_guard = max(0.2 t, 200 ps); skew.py (E) and arb_fork.py (J) use 0.772 early / 1.155 late (GUARD_LO/GUARD_HI).
conventions.tcheck_mapping: for one form: node 0 = launch; each path is a chain of 10a arcs [lo, hi] from node 0; data = the end nodes of the data paths; req = one node joined by the request paths' ends (the earliest change of any); setup = margin_ps. tcheck's PASS is then `verdict_sound` (every data change precedes every request change by setup). A shared arc on both sides (same element, as in setup_pulse) is CPPR-pessimistic under FixedRun (C-10a corr).

constraints.exactness_note: Bdg (formal/notes/B-lib-gap-delay.md): exact (iff) over the per-pin delay box (H_PIN_READ, read maps need not be monotone), for both specs, ONLY under four per-route side conditions (field exact_under) that delimit where per-stage necessity holds; outside them the row is sufficient only (flush_of_gflush / no_early_of_gflush need no side condition). H_BAL_HI (stages k+1 < N: Vd(k+1) <= Vd k + (p k).hi, i.e. (q 1).hi <= r0.hi + r1.hi + (p 1).hi and (q k).hi <= (q(k-1)).hi + (p k).hi), H_LO_ORDER ((q k).lo <= (q i).lo + sum_{j=i+1..k} (p j).lo for i < k), H_START (F + (q(N-1)).hi <= T + (q i).lo + sum_{j>i} (p j).lo), and for NoEarly H_SHORT ((q i).lo < Llo(i+1)). Necessity is FALSE without H_LO_ORDER (rescue_*: a slow later tap covers the hole). Necessity uses independent per-pin corners (box); under a correlated corner model it is the box corner, always sound for sufficiency. Supersedes GcdCells/ConstraintsFastFall's sufficient forms for this obligation. Not covered: glitch-freedom of the new token's rising edge itself under non-monotone maps (FIFO: GcdCells.rises), the data bundled (rule A), the gate waveform (H_GATE_PULSE), and mid-rail X inside the LUT2 mux (H_KLEENE_LUT), hence strict_pending stays.

The request and feedback windows drop out of the condition (they only shape the failure: latched wrong-branch token if the bad window outlasts the loop, else a recirculating runt). Necessity per join: unselected join with the other client's request waiting; selected join with its request waiting (setup) or already fallen (hold). Box necessity assumes pin delays independent; under a correlated corner model use join_pin_exact per realisation. O6 LUT arcs are flat over pins in prjxray, so the per-pin content is the site pins SP[I1], SP[I2]. Supersedes the window-model sufficient form (ConstraintsMux.*_unsel_low_timed) for this obligation. constraints.exactness_note: Bmx (formal/notes/B-lib-gap-mux.md): exact (iff) per join over the delay box with PER-PIN reads of all four live pins (x/y_req I0, ctl_req I1, s I2, own feedback I3; read maps need not be monotone), s adversarial outside [S0,S1), the client request arbitrary. The request and feedback windows drop out of the condition (they only shape the failure: latched wrong-branch token if the bad window outlasts the loop, else a recirculating runt). Necessity per join: unselected join with the other client's request waiting; selected join with its request waiting (setup) or already fallen (hold). Box necessity assumes pin delays independent; under a correlated corner model use join_pin_exact per realisation. O6 LUT arcs are flat over pins in prjxray, so the per-pin content is the site pins SP[I1], SP[I2]. Supersedes the window-model sufficient form (ConstraintsMux.*_unsel_low_timed) for this obligation. Not covered: bdc_muxn (other INITs; its rows are bdc_muxn.s_setup / s_hold), the ctl_req fork as a C rule K obligation, the source of S0/S1, mid-rail select (H_KLEENE_LUT).

rule.detail: rule I audits every controller whose data enters from a link stage that also requests it, through any combinational path, so a link->fork->link branch is covered, with the closing path t_rise + t_ack + t_fall (the wlo credit). Branches whose producer is not a bd_link stage (amerge index, compute outputs, steer/mux outputs, environment) print 'not audited'; for those, rule A (uor-audited cells) covers the producer's own cone but not the fork branch's route skew. UNCONFIRMED on a routed tighten log.
